name: dutch-tax-for-expats
description: Plain-language guidance on Dutch taxes for expats and freelancers: the 30% ruling (expatregeling) and its 27% change in 2027, Box 3 on assets abroad, the end of partial non-resident status, moving to or from the Netherlands, and the tax basics of freelancing (zzp) in the Netherlands. Made by Red Robot DNA, a Dutch bookkeeping firm.
